summary: The apt module can return cache_update_time, cache_updated, stderr and stdout.
questions: How can I tell if the apt task actually refreshed the cache?
How do I see apt's output from a registered result?
When was the apt cache last updated according to Ansible?

answer_card.title: apt return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `cache_updated` (bool): whether the cache was updated
- `cache_update_time` (int): time of last cache update (0 if unknown)
- `stdout` / `stderr`: output from apt (when needed)
